title: Are Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) Bots? People Review Your Resume?
description:
Is your resume really getting rejected by a bot or AI? What's an Applicant Tracking System? How does it affect your job search? Are real recruiters reading each and every resume that's submitted? Does it matter if you submit your resume as a Word document or a PDF?

In this video, we'll cover all of that and more. Here's a look at what a recruiter REALLY sees in the applicant tracking system when they're evaluating your resume.

To learn more, head to https://www.tealhq.com/tools/resume-builder
